def Roth.eta : (δ : Real) → (m : Nat) → Real :=
fun (δ : Real) (m : Nat) ↦
  @HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHMul.{0} Real Real.instMul)
    (@HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} Real Nat Real
      (@instHPow.{0, 0} Real Nat (@NPow.toPow.{0} Real (@Monoid.toNPow.{0} Real Real.instMonoid)))
      (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 10)
        (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo.{0} Real (nat_lit 10) Real.instNatCast Roth.eta._proof_1))
      m)
    (@HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHPow.{0, 0} Real Real Real.instPow) δ
      (@HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} Real Nat Real
        (@instHPow.{0, 0} Real Nat (@NPow.toPow.{0} Real (@Monoid.toNPow.{0} Real Real.instMonoid)))
        (@HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHDiv.{0} Real (@DivInvMonoid.toDiv.{0} Real Real.instDivInvMonoid))
          (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 1) (@One.toOfNat1.{0} Real Real.instOne))
          (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 2)
            (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo.{0} Real (nat_lit 2) Real.instNatCast Roth.gam._proof_1)))
        m))
